config.greedy-gold.title: Greedy Gold Configuration
Time between each regeneration tick (default: 5 seconds)
config.greedy-gold.usePercentage.tooltip: Use percentage of max durability instead of fixed amount
config.greedy-gold.regenAmount.tooltip: Durability points to restore (fixed mode only)
config.greedy-gold.regenPercentage.toolt: Percentage of max durability to restore (percentage mode only, default: 1%)
config.greedy-gold.upgradesEnabled.toolt: Enable the upgrade system for golden items
config.greedy-gold.showUpgradeTooltip.to: Show uses remaining until next upgrade in tooltip
config.greedy-gold.useRandomAffinity.too: Each item gets a random upgrade speed multiplier (makes armor pieces upgrade at different rates)
config.greedy-gold.minAffinity.tooltip: Minimum upgrade speed multiplier (lower = slower upgrades). Example: 0.8 = 20% slower
config.greedy-gold.maxAffinity.tooltip: Maximum upgrade speed multiplier (higher = faster upgrades). Example: 1.2 = 20% faster
config.greedy-gold.enchantUpgradeBaseUse: Base Uses for First Enchant Upgrade
Number of uses required for the first enchantment upgrade
config.greedy-gold.enchantUpgradeModifie: Multiplier for each subsequent enchantment upgrade (exponential growth)
config.greedy-gold.enchantArmorWeaponMod: Multiplier for armor and weapon enchantment upgrades (makes them take longer than tools if > 1.0)
Maximum Protection level for armor pieces (default: 6)
config.greedy-gold.durabilityUpgradeBase: Base Uses for First Durability Upgrade
Number of uses required for the first durability upgrade
config.greedy-gold.durabilityUpgradeModi: Multiplier for each subsequent durability upgrade (exponential growth)
config.greedy-gold.maxDurabilityLevel.to: Maximum number of durability upgrades (each adds +1 max durability)
config.greedy-gold.durabilityArmorWeapon: Multiplier for armor and weapon durability upgrades (makes them take longer than tools if > 1.0)
config.greedy-gold.miningLevelIronDurabi: Total max durability required for tools to mine at iron level (default: 200 = can mine diamonds)
config.greedy-gold.miningLevelDiamondDur: Total max durability required for tools to mine at diamond level (default: 550 = can mine obsidian)
